tagline: Istanbul's planned satellite city in the northwest — a modern, family-oriented district with wide avenues, parks, and good metro connections.

items.name: Başakşehir Olivium AVM Kafeler
items.description: Shopping centre cafés in the main commercial hub of Başakşehir. Practical and well-stocked.

items.name: Başakşehir Şehir Parkı
items.description: A large urban park — one of Istanbul's newer green spaces with walking paths, sports facilities, and family areas.

tips: Başakşehir is on the M3 metro line — about 45-50 minutes from the city centre.
A planned residential district — clean, modern, and family-oriented but lacking the character of older Istanbul neighbourhoods.
Popular with Turkish families seeking affordable modern housing with good schools.
Istanbul Başakşehir FC stadium is in the area — worth visiting on a match day.
